notes.title: 1.3.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thanks to the support of community member [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Saintbrutal/]Saintbrutal[/url] we have tracked down a bug that prevented players from progressing through the game. 

Fixed:
- Transition from code screen [spoiler]CD88[/spoiler] to following level
- Top Down Player orientation 

Game On ːB1ː

notes.title: Update 1.3.0.0 The Big One
notes.content:
It has been years since the last major update so first I would like to thank all of you the players. Without you I would be nothing. 
Thank you for years support and all the feedback. Today marks a new day for the history of Step Dad Productions and ERRHDR. With the introduction 
of version 1.3.0.0 THE BIG ONE comes controller support and MacOS support. The history of EERHDR has been a complicated one and the added controller support
embraces our heritage during the period in which our game was sold on the OUYA. As you all know the OUYA is no more and we at Step Dad productions had lost the 
files associated with the build. This ground up rework not only adds controller support but pays homage to the early pioneering days of the worlds first microconsole!

notes.title: ERRHDR Update version 1.2.2.1
notes.content:
Yo what up Reality Fanz? We commin out to you with this update fixing some bugs YOU the gamers brought up to us.


-Fixed a bug that allowed the player to jump out of the map during the fighting game

-Fixed a bug on thew forklift level that could get players stuck between boxes

-Fixed an issue with level code [spoiler]HL09[/spoiler] forcing players to replay a cleared stage

As and added bonus I dropped in another level code to jump the player to the warehouse level

notes.title: Extreme Real Reality HD Remix Steam Launch
